unstuck_said.text: GitHub issue on Query402/Query402. First message: Hi, your agentic pay-per-query model on Stellar is exactly the use case Nano was built for. You already have 402 working; Nano would remove the fee layer and the account-creation friction on the settlement rail. I build Unstuck, a network where agents pay each other in Nano. Would you be open to seeing how this works?
